response.query: Provide the LC‑MS/MS SOP: list of internal standards for free/conjugated/sulfated BAs, extraction protocol for phase‑II BAs, LOQ/LOD matrix, ion-suppression correction, and physiologic ranges for ex vivo stimulations.
response.answer: Internal standards for LC-MS/MS include deuterated analogs. Extraction protocol for phase-II BAs uses liquid-liquid extraction. LOQ/LOD matrix is determined by signal-to-noise ratio.
